observations: Photo 0 shows the motorcycle instrument cluster with two analog gauges, handlebars, key in the ignition, and a brake fluid reservoir.
Photo 1 shows the black fuel tank with the word "Kawasaki" visible on the side, a black seat, and a textured wall background.
Photo 2 shows the rear wheel with a red-rim stripe, chain drive, disc brake, swingarm, and exhaust muffler.

claims.evidence: Brand Kawasaki is readable in photo 1, but the model ZZR is not readable in any photo; it appears only in the seller's words.
Photos are static; there is no evidence the engine runs or that electrical systems function.
Seller's stated motive cannot be checked remotely.

risks.risk: Engine does not run or has serious mechanical faults
risks.proof: Video of a cold start and the engine running under load

risks.risk: Frame or accident damage not visible in the angled close-ups
risks.proof: Full walkaround video showing the frame, forks, subframe, and both sides

risks.risk: Missing, forged, or incomplete ownership/registration papers
risks.proof: Photo of the original vehicle documents
Clear close-up photo of the odometer display

risks.risk: Electrical faults in lights, indicators, or horn
risks.proof: Video demonstrating all lights and electrical functions

proof_requests: Clear photo of the model badge or decals showing "ZZR" and engine capacity
Video of the engine starting and running
Full walkaround video showing frame, forks, subframe, and overall condition
Close-up photo of the odometer reading
response.reason: The brand Kawasaki is visible on the tank, but the model ZZR is only in the seller's words and not readable in the photos; the model determines the market comparables, so even a worst-case price cannot be set without confirming the exact model.
